questions.ask: What name should I use for you: the one that appears on screen and in my notes?
What is the business or brand called?
What is your main handle, and on which platform do you post most?
Which platform do you post on most: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn?
In one sentence: what do you help people with, and who are they?
What is your accent colour (the one colour used for the key word, the focal element and the glow)?
(saved with the accent colour) the plain word for it: blue, gold, lime
Which font do you use for headlines?
(found on their computer) the bold weight of the main font
(found on their computer) the regular or medium weight of the main font; left unset, the bold is reused
Do you want key words in a second, contrasting font, or the same font in your colour?
(found on their computer) the emphasis font; the shipped Playfair Display Italic if they have no preference
Captions in the same main font, or a different one?
(found on their computer) the caption font; left unset, the main bold is reused
Transcribe with ElevenLabs (recommended, the most accurate word timings) or on this computer (free)?
Where should finished videos go? Next to the raw file in an '- Edit' folder is the default.
questions.default: beside the raw file, in a "<video name> - Edit" folder

questions.ask: Is your raw footage on an external drive? Which one?
Do you have a sound-effects pack (whooshes, pops, clicks)? Tell me the folder.
questions.default: none yet (videos are delivered without sound effects)

questions.ask: Where do you keep music you are allowed to use?
Should I always ask before adding music, or add a favourite and tell you which?
Where do you keep the real things I can show on screen: client results, proof, screenshots?
Should I check design choices with you before I build (which interface on which sentence, the wording, the opening), or build the whole reel my way and tell you what I chose?

When they name a platform, account or document, the edit is strongest with the real thing. May I fetch real thumbnails, avatars, logos and screenshots from the web? You decide what you are comfortable publishing; I list every source in my report.
questions.default: yes: real over drawn, every source listed in the report

questions.ask: Is there anything that must never be shown on screen: names, clients, competitors, figures, old offers, topics?
How dark should the background be behind the graphics, so dark panels read against your room? 0 = none, 0.4 = standard, 0.6 = heavy.
How strong may the punch-in on a sentence cut get? 1.06 gentle, 1.10 standard, 1.14 strong.
How big should the captions be, in pixels on the 1080 x 1920 frame?
How low on the chest should the captions sit (top edge, in pixels from the top of the frame)? Never above 1100 or below 1250.
How big should the one or two emphasis words per sentence be, in pixels?
(measured from a still of your cut, not asked) where your head sits at scale 1: x0 y0 x1 y1 in the 1080 x 1920 frame.
